checks: Complete source diff reviewed against frozen v24. All114 readl/writel/readl_poll_timeout/usleep_range/dma_wmb/dma_rmb/dma_alloc_coherent/dma_free_coherent calls have identical arguments and source order. Both mandatory reset fences, quarantine, OWN checking, errors, tuning and 64KiB caps are preserved.

Timing opt-in is default false, read-only module parameter. Ordinary CMD17/18/24/25 require direction-consistent data and !tuning_running; associated SBC/error-stop commands are part of that normal request sample. Initialization/tuning are excluded.

Stack sample is816bytes, bounded32events. Overflow, invalid segment and backwards timestamp increment loss markers and discard the entire sample from request/segment totals. CPU out-of-range classification compares real identifiers before bucket8; different real CPUs in bucket8 are not falsely marked same.

Instrumentation segments preserve nesting. command_wait includes command register writes, hardware duration, polling sleep and run delay; it is not hardware-only. completion_callback tightly brackets mmc_request_done. worker_total ends before final aggregate merge and does not include all instrumentation overhead.

Allmrq/data values are captured and active_sample cleared before mmc_request_done. Callback may enqueue another work item or release mrq; subsequent code accesses only local sample and live host aggregation state. The ordered queue serializes workers.

Each timestamp uses get_cpu/ktime_get_ns/put_cpu, keeping endpoint identity consistent without affinity between endpoints. Same endpoints do not establish residency or no intervening migration. Different endpoints indicate at least one migration only.

Normal debugfs_create_file full-proxy open protects host while copying under timing spinlock; open creates an independent snapshot, show/release do not dereference host. remove removes debugfs before host teardown. max is explicitly lifetime-only and not subtractable.

Snapshots contain only post-callback merged samples. Userspace can wake first; background ordinary I/O and adjacent measurement windows prevent unconditional count equality. Collector retains first-after and bounded stable-after observations, raw hashes and explicit limitations.

Actual C emitter and real aggregation header were compiled with ASan/UBSan, then parsed by collector. Empty/migrated/multi-command/copy snapshots accepted; malformed endpoints, poll-count inconsistency and duplicate rows rejected. Maxima stay before/after values, never subtracted.

Collector pins the unchanged read-cost probe c5b7ae1169bdab4cbc690d13f01b7e1b6f627f1cbe523fdbcbad96829a611946, kernel/boot identity and regular file on179:4. It does not change counter state, request size, cache, tuning, clocks or affinity.

Stable sample counters are not a device drain and do not prove zero outstanding requests.
